versions.label: v1.4.0 (PR #1 Legacy Indicator)

strengths: Visual CHoCH + Source RVOL arrow signals on TradingView chart.

versions.label: v2.0.0 (Legacy Pine Strategy Reference)
versions.executionModel: MARKET_NEXT_OPEN, SL 1.5 ATR, RR 1.0, maxHold 20, no BE+

versions.label: v3.0.0 (SMC High-WinRate Pine + Verified Parity)
versions.era: TradingView Pine v6 + Node Parity (1x Unlevered Spot/1x Perp)
versions.executionModel: 1x LIMIT_PULLBACK, 3.0-3.2 ATR / >=1.0-1.4% SL floor, RR 1.15, Confirmed-Close BE+

versions.label: v4.0 (3-Year OKX Perp Migration & Base Filters)
versions.executionModel: 1x OKX Swap 3Y (2023-11..2026-11), 0.05%/side taker cost, LIMIT_PULLBACK + BE+

1h_r5 held positive Blind Y3 OOS (+16.08% comp, PF 1.28, 7.70% DD) despite 2025-2026 bear conditions.

failureModes: 15m base signal without ML meta-labeling suffers fee/chop decay in Y3 bear/chop markets.

versions.label: v4.1 (VolNorm Leverage + 8h Funding + Partial TP1)
versions.era: Node Simulator 3Y OKX Perpetuals (VolNorm up to 3x + 0.01%/8h funding)
versions.executionModel: Volatility-Normalized Leverage (avg 2.39x, max 3x), 0.01%/8h funding drag, 50% TP1 option
strengths: VolNorm lifted BTC 1h 3Y compounded return from +75.83% (v4.0) to +267.14% (+26.45% in Blind Y3, 71.26% WR).
First version explicitly pricing 8h perpetual funding drag (-17.19% over 3Y on BTC 1h).
weaknesses: Direct un-tuned transfer of BTC rules to ETH (-73.15% comp) and SOL (-84.60% comp) collapsed catastrophically.
Fixed 0.01%/8h funding proxy & 0.05% taker fee assumption understated maker edge and missed real historical funding.
failureModes: Altcoin regime mismatch without asset-specific purged ML filtering; 15m VolNorm still lost -11.07% in Y3.

versions.label: v5.0 (Off-TV Autonomous Runtime + Purged ML + Post-Only + Real 8h Funding)
versions.era: Off-TV Node + Purged sklearn LR + Standalone SQLite Daemon
versions.executionModel: Post-Only Maker + Real 8h Funding + Purged LR ML probability sizing (0.85x-1.45x), maxTotalOpenLev=4
strengths: BTC 1h+15m ML portfolio achieved +1,943.80% 3Y compounded (+61.46% Blind Y3, 71.38% WR, PF 1.57) under Post-Only.
Delivered standalone SQLite WAL daemon, real OKX/Binance API clients, and <1e-12 Python/JS ML inference parity.

Altcoins (ETH/SOL) failed strict promotion gates over 3Y and were gated off.
failureModes: Strict Taker Holdout Y3 compressed sharply (+15.20% comp, PF 1.11); 3Y history missed the 2021-2022 crypto bear test.

versions.label: v6.0 (5Y Crypto Orderflow CVD + 10Y US Stock Indices & 2Y Futures)
versions.executionModel: 5Y 1h Crypto CVD/VWAP-Z/Orderflow + 10Y Daily US Equities IBS/Connors + 2Y 1h Futures
assetUniverse: Crypto Qualified: BTCUSDT, BNBUSDT, SOLUSDT (ETHUSDT gated out)
US Equities: SPY, DIA, QQQ (10Y Daily) + ES=F, YM=F, NQ=F (2Y 1h)
strengths: Proved edge over a full 5-year crypto cycle (2022 bear + 2023-2025 bull + Y5): Qualified BTC+BNB+SOL hit +19,750.27% (Post-Only) and +111.22% in Blind Y5.
First cross-asset expansion: US Stock Indices hit +492.48% (19.48% CAGR, PF 1.70, DD 21.82%) over 10Y and 2Y Futures hit +53.92% (PF 1.67, DD 15.67%).
weaknesses: Qualified Crypto still had 51.49% Cal max DD (58.06% Taker); US Equities Holdout 2Y dipped to +9.94% (61.80% WR, DD 21.82%).
Crypto Portfolio WR (~69.56%) was below >=75% consistency target and lacked monthly cashflow sweep metrics.
failureModes: ETHUSDT failed Blind Y5 (-9.90% comp Post-Only) under v6 symmetric long/short modeling.

versions.label: v7.0 (>=75% WR & >=30%/mo Zero-Liquidation Frontier + Two-Stage TP1)
versions.era: 5Y 15m+1h Crypto Two-Stage Maker Exit + MMR 0.5% + Monthly Sweep Accounting
versions.executionModel: Two-stage Maker Exit (TP1 0.65R +0.30R BE Lock) + Monthly Sweep & Compounded MMR 0.5% Liq Audit
strengths: Proved mathematically that >=75% WR AND >=30%/mo (Cal+Val +31.65%/mo, Full 5Y +24.87%/mo) is achievable with 0 liquidations.
Rehabilitated ETH & SOL into >75% WR contributors via Two-Stage TP1 + Locked BE+.
Futures high-WR helper (ES=F + NQ=F) hit 77.01% WR, PF 1.88, +50.07% comp, 12.30% DD.
weaknesses: Blind Bear Y5 (2025-11..2026-11) suffered severe tail risk: -59.19% worst month and -85.47% max DD on Tier 3 (-1.90%/mo PO, -8.61%/mo Taker).
Used symmetric ML and uniform leverage across bull, bear, and range chop.
failureModes: Counter-trend long dip-buying during the Y5 bear regime compressed Blind Y5 WR from 78.43% to 69.38% (PF 0.92).

versions.label: v8.0 (Causal Macro-Trend Regime Engine + Asymmetric L/S ML + Equities v8)
versions.era: 5Y 15m+1h Crypto (Asymmetric 16 L/S ML + Cross-Asset Breadth) + Equities/Futures v8
versions.executionModel: Causal 1D+4H Regime Engine + 3/4-Asset Breadth + Independent Long/Short GBC/LR Ensembles
strengths: Cut Tier 3 worst month from -59.19% (v7) to -36.67% (v8) and raised Full 5Y Tier 3 to 78.86% WR, PF 1.74, Calmar 8.28, Zero-Liq.
Tier 1 SAFE raised Full 5Y Sharpe from 2.56 -> 3.11 (+9.58%/mo) and cut worst month to -23.66%.
US Equities Blind Holdout 2Y recovered from 61.80% -> 67.05% WR (+11.98% vs +9.94%, DD cut 21.82% -> 16.19%); ES=F hit 80.00% WR.
weaknesses: Crypto Blind Holdout Y5 remained negative (-3.24%/mo Tier 1, -5.67%/mo Tier 3 Post-Only; WR dropped to ~65-66%).
Rule-based regime multiplier (aligned_boost) lacked true Walk-Forward adaptive bear suppression & short-only/defensive ensemble gating.
failureModes: Bear-market long bleed in 2025-11..2026-11 overwhelmed Y5 mean monthly sweep even with 0 liquidations.

versions.label: v9.0 (3-Slice Cal/Val Sub-Period Screening + Single Cal-Fit ML + Causal DD Guard)
versions.era: 5Y 15m+1h Crypto 3-Slice Cal/Val Sub-Period Screening + Single Cal-Fit ML + Causal DD Guard
versions.executionModel: 3-Slice Cal/Val Sub-Period Screening + Single Cal-Fit ML + Bear-Fold Short Gating + Causal Closed-Trade DD Guard (15%->0.70x until <8%) + Two-Stage TP1
assetUniverse: Qualified (6/8): BTC_1h, BNB_1h, ETH_1h, BTC_15m, SOL_15m, ETH_15m
Gated out by strict CV/fold bar: SOL_1h, BNB_15m (Shorts disabled on BNB_1h & ETH_15m by F1 Bear gate)
strengths: Genuine zero-Y5-tuning expanding walk-forward gate (6/8 passed F1>=1.05, F2>=1.15, F3>=1.25, CV_WR>=70%) + <1e-12 Py/JS parity.
Causal DD Guard cut SAFE_V9 Full 5Y maxDD to 46.89% (vs v8 Safe 61.66%) and worst month to -19.79% (vs v8 -23.66%) with 0 liquidations.
MAXIMIZED_V9 hit +38.37%/mo Cal+Val (44.90% months >=30%/mo, Calmar 36.38) and +28.38%/mo Full 5Y (+3,036,720.88% comp).
weaknesses: Even with strict Walk-Forward stacking & DD Guard, Blind Holdout Y5 Crypto Bear remained negative across tiers (-2.81%/mo / -33.91% SAFE_V9; -5.35%/mo BALANCED_V9; -9.52%/mo MAXIMIZED_V9).
Full 5Y WR (~72.53% Post-Only, ~71.76% Taker) sits slightly below v8 in-sample 76-79% due to non-re-tuned Bear Y5 (58.95% WR).
failureModes: Bear-year choppy trend reversals in 2025-11..2026-11 still compress WR to ~58.95% on qualified crypto unless paired with US Index Futures/ETFs.

versions.label: v14.0 (True Expanding Walk-Forward Retraining (6-Epoch Causal Purge + CV AUC >= 0.52 Abstention Gate))
versions.era: 5Y 15m+1h Crypto True Expanding Walk-Forward Retraining (6-Epoch Causal Purge + CV AUC >= 0.52 Abstention Gate)
versions.executionModel: True Expanding Walk-Forward Retraining (6-Epoch Causal Purge, Recency Half-Life 365d, CV AUC >= 0.52 & Inner-Val Expectancy Abstention Gate, Causal DD Guard, MMR 0.5%)
assetUniverse: 8 Crypto Streams (8/8 evaluated across 48 main expanding OOS epochs; 47/48 active, 1 abstained in cash)
3 Expanding Tiers (SAFE_V14, BALANCED_V14, MAXIMIZED_V14) + Cross-Asset All-Weather (v14 Crypto + v8 ES=F/NQ=F Futures)
strengths: Strict zero-lookahead 6-epoch expanding retrain (exitTime <= epochStartTimeSec across 64/64 windows, <1e-12 Py/JS parity) raised Pure OOS [40..100%] SAFE_V14 to +136.11% (PF 1.17, Sharpe 1.04, DD 25.37%, Liq=0).

Cut Blind Holdout Y5 Crypto Bear losses vs v9 across every tier (SAFE_V14 -24.89% vs v9 -33.91%; BALANCED_V14 -32.09% vs v9 -57.36%; MAXIMIZED_V14 -65.57% vs v9 -81.76%) with 0 liquidations across 61 months.

Abstention gate shifted BTC_15m Epoch 5 & Live to cash during bear chop, while SOL_1h (+13.54%), ETH_15m (+2.13%), and BTC_1h (+1.01%) turned Blind Y5 positive; v14 Cross-Asset 2Y Overlap hit +283.08% (Calmar 2.04, Liq=0).
weaknesses: Portfolio Blind Y5 Crypto Bear aggregate remained negative (-24.89% SAFE_V14 Post-Only) due to 2025-11..2026-11 BTC/BNB/ETH_1h drawdowns.
Only 1/48 main epochs abstained because most expanding windows passed Inner-Val PF >= 1.05 before shifting into Y5 bear microstructure.
failureModes: Aggregate long-heavy pullback fills during multi-quarter crypto bear trends still face negative Y5 drift (-1.94%/mo) unless hedged by non-crypto trend/futures sleeves.
